measured_obstacle_to_the_full_lane.first_attempt: a hand-typed 8-point SCL lane and 8-point SDA lane from the pair corridor to U1.47/U1.48
measured_obstacle_to_the_full_lane.result: 22 foreign hits (SCL) and 21 (SDA) against pads: E2.7/E2.8 (GND/MCU_VDD), U5.4 (PWR_CTRL_OUT), U1.19/U1.20 (GND), plus SDA clipping SCL's own pad E2.6
measured_obstacle_to_the_full_lane.reading: the E2/U1 pad field is dense, so 'draw the lane fully' is not a hand-typed constant: it needs an obstacle-aware path.
measured_obstacle_to_the_full_lane.honest_note: R-h's slots/corridor/pitch remain valid; only the pad-avoiding run is open.

proposed_method_for_the_freeze.method: draft the lane ONCE with the in-register router on the CLEARED field (a drawing action, not an exam run), then FREEZE the resulting polyline as a constant in the spec and re-emit it with the stitcher.
proposed_method_for_the_freeze.why_this_satisfies_sec.17.4_one_shot_dra: the solver is used as a DRAFTSMAN once; its output becomes a frozen drawing constant, so the later construction run performs no search for that lane.
proposed_method_for_the_freeze.alternative: or route the pair on B.Cu where the pad field is sparser (needs a measurement).
proposed_method_for_the_freeze.ask: confirm the drafting-as-drawing method (or pick the B.Cu alternative) - then R-h freezes, R-g lands per the C6/zone decision, and ONE construction + ONE N=1 follow.
